**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Don't block config generation on running reserved singleton**

When the host task-orchestrator is already listening on 7890, this branch makes `allocate_ports_map` return BLOCKED unless there is an active lease for the port. But the new catalog marks task-orchestrator as `reserved_singleton`, so this allocator intentionally never writes such a lease; `dopemux mcp init` and `repair-config` include task-orchestrator by default and call this before the lifecycle Docker identity gate. The result is that normal config-only repair/init fails whenever the reserved singleton is already running, even for the same project. Treat reserved singletons as fixed config exports here and leave live ownership blocking to doctor/lifecycle.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
